name: Tominaga Ryou
source:
A third-year student from a different junior high school who also participated in the extracurricular activities camp. He is unable to accept the reality that he has ended up lost in another world. To hide his anxiety, he tries to make himself look better. Though the more he does this, the more his cowardice begins to show.

He is is afraid and disgusted by his digimon partner, Kunemon.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2019/12/digimon-survive-details-more-story-ryou-kunemon-and-search-action]Gematsu's translation[/url]]
